lesson.title: Review Day: Pronouns, Plurals, and Reading Fluency
lesson.subject: punjabi

contentBlocks.text: ਇਸ ਹਫ਼ਤੇ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਬਹੁਤ ਨਵੇਂ ਸ਼ਬਦ ਸਿੱਖੇ। ਆਓ ਸਭ ਕੁਝ ਦੁਹਰਾਈਏ! (This week you learned many new words. Let's review it all!)

Quick review: ਮੈਂ, ਤੂੰ, ਉਹ are pronouns that replace nouns (Day 1). Plural nouns change form, like ਕੁੜੀ becoming ਕੁੜੀਆਂ (Day 2). Pronouns and plural nouns combine into sentences with matching plural verbs (Day 3). This week's whole story used all of it together (Day 4). Write one pronoun, one plural noun, and one full sentence using both.
ਬਹੁਤ ਵਧੀਆ ਕੰਮ! (Wonderful work!) You learned pronouns, plurals, and read a real story this week. Next week we'll keep building your Punjabi skills.

objectives: Review this week's pronouns, plural nouns, sentence-building, and story
Recall and correctly write at least one pronoun, one plural noun, and a combined sentence
teacherGuide.facilitationScript:
1. Do the quick walk-through review of all 4 days together, out loud.
2. Have the child write one pronoun and one plural noun from memory.
3. Have the child write one original sentence combining both.
4. Complete the review worksheet.
5. Celebrate finishing a full week of new Punjabi grammar!
differentiationTips: Struggling: allow the child to look back at this week's worksheets while writing the review words, rather than requiring pure recall
Ready for more: ask the child to write a sentence using a pronoun AND a plural noun AND an adjective from week 1, all in one sentence
This is a good checkpoint to note which of this week's three new elements (pronouns, plurals, or sentence-building) needs the most review before next week
teacherGuide.answerKey: This is a recall and review activity — check that the child correctly writes one pronoun (ਮੈਂ/ਤੂੰ/ਉਹ), one plural noun (ਕੁੜੀਆਂ/ਮੁੰਡੇ/ਕਿਤਾਬਾਂ/ਬੱਚੇ), and that their combined sentence uses correct plural verb agreement.
teacherGuide.standardsRationale: Consolidates this week's pronoun, plural, and sentence-building content before the course continues, matching the established Day-5-review pacing used across every unit this session.
